text: Today. [pause] Ten o'clock. [pause] The gates open.
Two hundred metres. [pause] Behind a double fence, six metres high, walks the most famous predator that ever lived.
Tyrannosaurus rex. [pause] Twelve metres long. [pause] Around eight tonnes.
Its bite was the strongest of any land animal we know: more than three tonnes of force.
Fifteen metres. [pause] A long-neck lifts its head over the fence, right above the visitors.
The biggest of them, Argentinosaurus, could weigh around seventy tonnes. [pause] As much as ten elephants.
You would feel every footstep through your shoes.
Then the T. rex stops. [pause] And slowly turns its head… towards the tower.
Its eyes faced forward, like ours. [pause] It could judge distance.
And tonight, a storm is coming.
